description: This file defines an interface `MockSensor` that extends several capability interfaces related to device features such as fault detection, tamper detection, battery power, temperature measurement, and trouble status. It serves as a marker interface within a device simulation framework, providing a default method to access the associated device object.

classes.name: MockSensor
classes.description: Marker interface for sensors that extends multiple device capability interfaces.

methods.name: getDevice
methods.description: Returns the associated device cast to `MockZigbeeDevice`.
